patch.summary: GoTo Connect cost guide: researched plan structure, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: GoTo Connect pricing is plan-gated across 4 researched tiers. No free plan confirmed in SoftwareGlimpse research. No free/trial flag confirmed in SG data — budget a paid pilot. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.heading: GoTo Connect cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price GoTo Connect against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Scope a time-boxed pilot; No free/trial flag confirmed in SG data — budget a paid pilot.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (cloud phone, call routing, call recording) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: No published self-serve seat dollars — every plan is sales-quoted. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

blocks.title: GoTo Connect cost mistakes to avoid

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: No published self-serve seat dollars — every plan is sales-quoted

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Industry dollar ranges are low confidence and must not be treated as list prices

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: AI Receptionist and some AI analytics are add-ons

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: WhatsApp, shared inbox and unified inbox depth require CX / Contact Center ladders

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Auto-dialer and full agent tooling sit on Contact Center, not Phone System
